summary: Independent verification of the Offer Letter Pro v6 (pdf-v15-offer-letter-pro-v6) 4-variant redesign. Rendered all 4 lifecycle variants (original/accepted/declined/rescinded) via direct call to _generate_offer_pdf using the real db.career_offers doc enriched in-memory (no DB mutation, no emails). Extended /app/backend/tests/test_offer_letter_pro_pdf.py with a new permanent TestVariantAssertions class (16 new tests) covering every assertion listed in the review request. Full suite (42 tests) and the offer_lifecycle_guardrails suite (3 tests) pass. /api/health returns 200. Theme signature constant confirmed at 'pdf-v15-offer-letter-pro-v6'. Strict validation regression preserved. No frontend testing (per request: backend only).
critical_code_review_comments: careers_offers.py is ~1952 lines; consider splitting the PDF rendering (_generate_offer_pdf plus helpers) into a dedicated module (e.g. routes/offer_pdf/renderer.py) for maintainability. Not blocking but the file has grown well past the 700-line guideline.

The 'Signed by {legal_name}' sig-box header is used both as a real UI element and as a negative-assertion sentinel in tests; if the label is ever refactored, the accepted-variant regression will silently invert. Consider adding a shared string constant so tests and code cannot diverge.

Rescinded watermark relies on PyMuPDF extracting canvas.drawCentredString text; if a future change moves it to an image or path, the diagonal-watermark test will fail. Documented in the test docstring, acceptable for now.

hero_style branch for rescinded appends BACKGROUND for row 4 regardless of whether the row exists — it is guarded by the variant check above, but keeping the two guards adjacent would make future edits safer.

context_for_next_testing_agent: Offer Letter Pro v6 test file is now the single source of truth for lifecycle PDF regressions. New TestVariantAssertions class renders each variant once (class-scope fixture) and validates: accepted (badge, OFFER ACCEPTED ribbon, 'fully executed on', 'Your journey begins in N day(s)', FULLY EXECUTED AGREEMENT + ELECTRONIC SIGNATURE RECORD, CANDIDATE panel with signed_name, SHA-256 label, CEO signer + title, absence of the old 'Signed by {legal_name}' sig-box header, absence of SCAN TO ACCEPT, handwritten signature image embedded); declined (RESPECTFULLY DECLINED badge, HISTORICAL RECORD hero label, CANDIDATE RESPONSE closure card, decline_reason verbatim, 'The door remains open', standalone sig box PRESENT, no SCAN TO ACCEPT, no 'remaining to accept'); rescinded (RESCINDED - NO LONGER IN EFFECT badge, hero void band 'NO LONGER IN EFFECT' + 'THIS COMPENSATION PACKAGE IS VOID' checked separately for em-dash tolerance, FORMAL RESCISSION NOTICE, rescind_reason, 'Legal effect', 'void and of no further force or effect', diagonal RESCINDED watermark on page 1 detected via >=2 occurrences of RESCINDED, sig box present, no QR); original (YEAR-1 TOTAL COMPENSATION VALUE with no HISTORICAL RECORD, countdown 'remaining', SCAN TO ACCEPT + sig box present, no variant-specific phrases leaking in).
rca_of_the_issue: Not applicable — this iteration is verification of a shipped redesign, not a bug fix. All expected content strings are produced by _generate_offer_pdf across the 4 variants with the current OFFER_PDF_THEME_SIGNATURE == 'pdf-v15-offer-letter-pro-v6' constant.
